context.objective: Choose a bounded migration path for an existing project
constraints: do not change public behavior without review

candidates.action: Make the migration in two independently reversible steps
candidates.rationale: It limits blast radius and preserves an intermediate rollback point.
assumptions: the compatibility layer can remain for one release
downstream_effects: dependent tasks must accept the compatibility layer
candidates.rollback: Revert the second step, then remove the first step only after dependents migrate.
